description: Data and code for: Accounting convention, not capture technology, decides whether waste incinerators compete for geological CO2 storage is published by Cheng, Tianjiao; Onoda, Hiroshi. The code applies plant-level carbon balances to waste incinerators under alternative carbon-storage accounting rules. Its stated coverage is Japan; municipal incinerators operating in fiscal 2024. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is mit-license. Accounting assumptions drive comparisons and should not be interpreted as demonstrated capture performance. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
